title: Send email with Resend
description: Send transactional email through the Resend API with a caller token.

environment.name: RESEND_API_KEY
environment.description: API key from resend.com/api-keys with permission to send email.

environment.name: RESEND_FROM
environment.description: Verified sender address, for example Acme <hello@example.com>.

environment.name: RESEND_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Random token (at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32) callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token>; required because Neon Function URLs are public.
